Title: Question on Tariq and the Soul Gem

Messages.Author: Tetragrammaton
Messages.Body:
Hi, i would like to know how to handle this:

Tariq the Silent (without any master discipline) has a soul gem of Etrius,
he's burned, and i draw a 4 capacity vamp from my crypt:
what happens ?

Tariq is a at - 4 cap when controlled, yes, but when the soul gem does
compare
the age of the two vamp, before or *after* the burning of the vamp ?

Similar question:
if i got a burned 4 capacity vamp with the soul gem, and i draw Tariq from
my crypt,
what happens?

Thanks in advance

Emiliano, vekn Prince of Rome

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Tetragrammaton wrote:
>
> Hi, i would like to know how to handle this:
>
> Tariq the Silent (without any master discipline) has a soul gem of Etrius,
> he's burned, and i draw a 4 capacity vamp from my crypt:
> what happens ?

It is moved to your ready region with the Soul Gem.

> Tariq is a at - 4 cap when controlled, yes, but when the soul gem does
> compare
> the age of the two vamp, before or *after* the burning of the vamp ?

Before, which is why the Arika trick (enhancing her capacity with a
card-in-play) works.

>
> Similar question:
> if i got a burned 4 capacity vamp with the soul gem, and i draw Tariq from
> my crypt,
> what happens?

He's moved to your uncontrolled region, since his capacity is not yet reduced
(he's not in play, after all).
